Name: (AT) New Crop Variety - Alternative 1.6 Crops Textures
Author: MarcyTheBeast
Description:
[size=4]Overview[/size]

Adds alternative textures for all of the new crops introduced in 1.6.

Each crop gets new alternative textures which vary a bit from the original, they differ in color, sizes and shapes.

[size=4]Requirements[/size]

Requires: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.


[/b]Also recommended: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11317?tab=description]Messy Crops[/url][/b].

Downloads.Description: Added one new variety to carrots, summer squash and powdermelons. Minor sprite cleanups here and there.
